itemUsage.en: Rhodes Island Medic Operator Kal'tsit, returned after a short, unexpected parting.
itemUsage.zh: 罗德岛的医疗干员凯尔希，在经历过短暂的意外离别后，她回到了这里。

itemDesc.en: She has lost eternal life, and gained all the suffering, damage, and hope that ordinary people bear.
itemDesc.zh: 她失去了永恒的生命，得到了属于普通人的一切痛苦、残缺，还有希望。

description.en:
Attack Range <@ba.vup>expands</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, and attacks now release medical units (prioritizing enemies) that deal <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as True damage to all enemies around the target, <$ba.sluggish>Slow</> them for <@ba.vup>{attack@sluggish}</>s, and restore HP equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</> ATK to all allied Operators around the target
<@ba.rem>Skill activation grants 10 ammo; can manually deactivate skill</>
description.zh: 攻击范围<@ba.vup>扩大</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，攻击变为射出医疗单元（优先选择敌人），击中时对目标周围所有敌人造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的真实伤害，使其<$ba.sluggish>停顿</><@ba.vup>{attack@sluggish}</>秒并回复目标周围所有友方干员相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@heal_scale:0%}</>的生命\n<@ba.rem>攻击装有10发弹药，可以随时停止技能</>

description.en: Gain a Tactical Anchor Point; ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, Attack Interval <@ba.vup>decreases significantly</>, and heals <@ba.vup>1</> additional target; after deploying the Tactical Anchor Point, Kal'tsit Esperanta <$ba.addash>Moves</> to its position, and up to <@ba.vup>2</> allied Operators within her Attack Range can be brought along and deployed elsewhere within her new Attack Range
description.zh: 立刻获得战术锚点，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，攻击间隔<@ba.vup>大幅缩小</>，额外治疗<@ba.vup>1</>个目标，部署战术锚点后，自身<$ba.addash>移动</>至该位置，并使攻击范围内最多<@ba.vup>2</>名友方干员可以部署至自身攻击范围的另一位置
